title: Customer support automation (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: Illustrative benchmark: AI assistants typically deflect 20-40% of tier-1 tickets within six months of launch.
Illustrative benchmark: a human-handled ticket costs roughly USD 5-15, versus USD 0.5-2 for an automated resolution.
Buying a SaaS support-AI platform usually reaches production in 4-8 weeks; a custom build typically takes 4-6 months.
Human escalation paths and a feedback loop are the strongest predictors of customer satisfaction in AI-assisted support.

title: Cloud migration (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: Illustrative benchmark: lift-and-shift migrations commonly cut data-centre cost 15-30% but rarely deliver agility gains on their own.
Typical phases: assessment, landing zone, pilot workload, wave migrations, decommissioning.
Untracked egress, idle resources and over-provisioning are the top three causes of cloud cost overruns.

title: Mobile and web app delivery (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: Illustrative benchmark: a focused MVP typically takes 8-14 weeks with a team of 3-5 people.
Roughly 20-30% of project effort goes to testing, release management and app-store compliance.
Scope creep is the most common reason MVP timelines slip; a written must-have / nice-to-have list mitigates it.

title: Marketing campaigns (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: Illustrative benchmark: B2B email campaigns average a 2-5% click-through rate; paid social often lands at 0.5-1.5%.
A common budget split: 50-60% paid media, 20-25% content production, 10-15% tooling and analytics, 10% reserve.
Define one primary KPI per campaign (e.g. qualified leads) to avoid vanity-metric reporting.

title: HR and employee onboarding (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: Illustrative benchmark: structured onboarding improves first-year retention by roughly 20-80% depending on the study.
Best practice is a 30-60-90 day plan with a named buddy and a Day-1 checklist (access, equipment, introductions).
Completion tracking through an HRIS reduces missed compliance training.

title: Cybersecurity and compliance (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: Illustrative benchmark: ISO 27001 readiness for a small organisation commonly takes 4-9 months.
MFA, patching cadence and tested backups prevent the majority of common incidents.
Third-party and vendor access is a leading and frequently overlooked attack path.

title: Data and analytics programs (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: Illustrative benchmark: 60-80% of analytics project time is spent on data preparation and quality work.
Start with 3-5 decision-critical metrics rather than a broad dashboard rollout.
Data-ownership and refresh-frequency agreements prevent dashboard trust problems.

title: Process documentation and SOPs (illustrative benchmarks)
facts: A good SOP states purpose, scope, roles, step-by-step procedure, exceptions and a review cycle.
SOPs reviewed at least annually have markedly fewer drift-related incidents.
Each step should have one accountable role and one observable completion signal.
